components.name: Car App
components.detailsHtml:
New Features

  • App Theming: Added CarAppThemeSource to allow apps to opt into brand theming and hosts to query preferred theme configurations.
  • Search Header: Added SearchHeader for SectionedItemTemplate as a search header replacement in API 9.
  • Component Styling: Added styling support for tabs (TabStyle), banners (BannerStyle), and media controls/progress indicators (MediaPlaybackStyle, StrokeCap).

API Changes

  • Media & Progress Bar Styling: Added MediaPlaybackStyle, setMediaAccentColor, and standalone StrokeCap to customize playback controls and progress indicators. Updated CarProgressBarStyle to support nullable colors and removed deprecated color methods from CarProgressBar. (Ib45c6, I17141, I270a4, I10fe4, I80a17)
  • App Theming: Introduced CarAppThemeSource for public app theme opt-in and added onGetAppTheme to CarAppService (with corresponding IPC) allowing hosts to query preferred theme configurations. (I108f8, Ifbd41, I97c7e)
  • Tabs Styling: Added support for custom background colors, content/text colors, and custom corner radii via TabStyle. (I07330, Id09f6)
  • Icons & Image Sizing: Deprecated IMAGE_TYPE_ICON across Row, GridItem, Banner, and CondensedItem in favor of IMAGE_TYPE_SMALL and IMAGE_TYPE_MEDIUM size constants where icons render untinted by default. Reworked CarIconStyle and added custom shape support to CarIcon. (Ie57fa, I5cc2d, Ic9584, Iaef57)
  • Banners: Added BannerStyle for custom shapes and corner radii, added image variant options (IMAGE_TYPE_SMALL, IMAGE_TYPE_LARGE), and removed deprecated icon and background APIs in favor of setLeadingImage and addTrailingImage. (I265bb, I7d28a, I23f62, I2917e, I95b1c)
  • Headers & Layout: Introduced SearchHeader for SectionedItemTemplate in API 9, added startHeaderImage to Header for custom start icons, and added incompleteLastRowStrategy to control handling of partial rows/columns in grid, condensed, and spotlight sections. (I86632, I24937, If64be)

Bug Fixes

  • Clarified that Action.TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK is ignored as a template FAB on Car API 9+ hosts. (Ie8fd4)

  • Implement toString() for ScatterMap.asMap key, value, and entry views. This provides better debug visibility for developers using the asMap() wrapper. (I64791)

components.name: Compose Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Adds support to specify the style of individual parts of a compound composable (such as TextField or DatePicker) directly in the style parameter of the composable. This enables, for example, creating a TextField-like composable that allows customizing each of the decorator boxes using a style, enabling them to be overridden at a theme level or at the call site. (I43c0f)
  • Material 2 text field overloads that accept value, onValueChange parameters are deprecated. Please migrate to the overload that uses TextFieldState to hoist its state. (I6b841, b/556234973)
  • Removed @ExperimentalFoundationApi annotation from undoState in TextFieldState. (I93a44)
  • Add default configuration objects for each lazy layout containing the default values used in the corresponding @Composeable functions. Currently only contains the default cache window for each layout. (I58633)
  • Flag isUsingDynamicDefaultCacheWindowIn[List|Grid|StaggeredGrid]s when enabled will cause lazy layouts to use a cache window that uses the average size of visible items to prefetch ahead of the viewport with a minimum ahead window of 10% of the viewport and a maximum ahead window of 50% of the viewport. (I59212)
  • Deprecated LazyListPrefetchStrategy, LazyListPrefetchScope, and LazyListPrefetchResultScope. Prefetching behavior should be configured using LazyLayoutCacheWindow on LazyColumn or LazyRow. LazyLayoutCacheWindow provides a declarative, viewport-based caching mechanism that automatically prepares items ahead of and keeps items behind the visible window without requiring complex imperative scheduling callbacks. The new API is simpler and requires less configuration steps than LazyListPrefetchStrategy. (I1fa2d)
  • Adds PolygonShape.transformed and PolygonShape.scaledToFit extension functions in Compose Foundation for transforming and fitting polygon shapes. (I3f327)
  • This change refactors the Styles API into two independent pieces: the Styles DSL and the modifiers that are configured by the DSL. The previous Style-based implementation is still present but will be deprecated and removed. Any uses of it should be replaced with the new CommonStyle based API.
  • Key components introduced:
    • CustomStyle & CommonStyle: Base interfaces and merging helpers for declaring composable styles.
    • StyleResolver: Resolves style properties in composition and binds to layout nodes via Modifier.styleResolver.
    • Modifier scopes: Modifier.appearance, Modifier.placement, and dynamic callback-based Modifier.padding and Modifier.graphicsLayer.
    • Property primitives: stylePropertyOf, styleLocalOf.
    • Types useful for style properties: Breadth, Fill, and Shadows.
  • The new modifiers are useful for implementing a design system using the Styles API but are not required. A design system may use these modifiers or provide its own. (Ieb8cc, b/549921960)
  • Removed ExperimentalFoundationApi annotation from TextFieldBuffer APIs that track the changes (I546a7)
  • Introduces MorphPolygonShape in Compose Foundation for morphing animations between polygon shapes, along with toPolygonShape() converters for RoundedCornerShape and CutCornerShape. (Ic5a89)
  • Introduces PolygonShape in Compose Foundation for rendering regular, star, and custom rounded polygons with corner smoothing. (I0b99d)
  • BasicTextField overloads that accept value, onValueChange parameters are deprecated. Please migrate to the BasicTextField overload that uses TextFieldState to hoist its state. (I636bf, b/552879150)
  • Inline with BasicTextField(value, onValueChange), VisualTransformation is also deprecated since it is only exposed through this TextField flavor. Existing transformations should migrate to OutputTransformation. (I636bf, b/552879150)
  • Providing LazyLayoutCacheWindow and LazyListPrefetchStrategy via LazyListState has been deprecated in favour of providing a LazyLayoutCacheWindow to the composable function. (I71f19)
  • Removed temporary feature flag ComposeFoundationFlags.isPausableCompositionInPrefetchEnabled. (Ifff7f)
  • Added InputTransformation.maxLengthTrim to limit text length by truncating excess input characters, added InputTransformation.maxLengthReject to reject input that exceeds maxLength, and deprecated InputTransformation.maxLength in favor of maxLengthTrim and maxLengthReject. (I8d4cd)

Bug Fixes

  • compileSdk for Compose libraries updated to 37.1. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using Compose. (I05b0f)
  • Fixed an issue where WindowInsetsRulers IME insets were not marked as animating during predictive back, and fixed imePadding not updating when switching focus between text fields. (Id4562, b/537386261, b/539686000)
  • Updated SecureTextField and OutlinedSecureTextField components (as well as deprecated BasicSecureTextField overloads) to use TextObfuscationMode.System as the default obfuscation mode instead of TextObfuscationMode.RevealLastTyped. (I76c7e)

components.name: Room3
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added setConnectionPoolTimeout(timeout: Duration) to RoomDatabase.Builder to allow configuring the connection pool timeout. (I24d07, b/404380974)
  • The following Room annotations now have AnnotationTarget.PROPERTY: @ColumnInfo, @PrimaryKey, @Relation, @Embedded, @Ignore and @ColumnTypeConverters. This API changes make Room be 'property-centric' instead of the 'field-centric'. Meaning Room can now use properties without backing fields as representation of entity columns or query data class result columns. The properties must still have a usable getter and either a usable setter or be part of the primary constructor so that Room can use them for DAO functions. (I72058, b/438041176, b/521861812)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue on web and suspending drivers where cancelling a coroutine during a transaction could cause the database and connection to get into a bad state, preventing further usages. (If75c0, b/549860940)
  • Support Kotlin object implementing AutoMigrationSpec. (Id4077, b/215012591)
  • Fix a regression that would cause Room to throw an IllegalMonitorStateException when using @Transaction wrapper DAO functions. (I996d9, b/543285472, b/553140228)
  • Added built-in column type converter support for kotlin.uuid.Uuid in Room. (Icca77, b/525093264)
  • Room's Kotlin code generator now suppresses OPT_IN_USAGE_ERROR and OPT_IN_USAGE on generated _Impl classes, allowing DAOs and Entities to use @RequiresOptIn-annotated types (such as kotlin.uuid.Uuid) without requiring -opt-in in freeCompilerArgs. (I013bf, b/410607888)
  • Room suspending queries and invalidation tracker operations will now throw an IllegalStateException when called after the database has been closed. (I5755a, b/543076356)
  • Fix a deadlock that can occur on @Transaction DAO wrapper suspend functions that would do a context switch and had the AndroidSQLiteDriver configured. (886ac5, b/543285472)
  • Fix an unnecessary println() during processing. Thanks to Simon Marquis! (b/532893031)
  • Fix an issue regarding other database usages within another database's transaction mixing in leading undefined behaviour. (b/437068912)

components.name: Security
components.detailsHtml:
Major features of 1.0.0:

  • UpdateInfoService Framework: Base service enabling OEM OTA clients and update services to declare and broadcast available security update metadata.
  • Available Security Patch Level (ASPL): Standardizes reporting the newest available patch level across system and subsystem updates to on-device consumers.
  • Kotlin & Java Compatibility: Provides UpdateInfoService for Kotlin Coroutines (fetchUpdates()) and ListenableFutureUpdateInfoService for Java clients using Guava ListenableFuture (fetchUpdatesAsync()).
  • Extensible Provider Configuration: Includes configurable caching, rate-limiting, and error-handling hooks.

components.name: Security
components.detailsHtml:
Major features of 1.1.0

  • Unified Security State Querying (SecurityPatchState): Provides a unified programmatic view of on-device security patch levels across the system, system modules (Mainline), and kernel.
  • Pending Update Discovery (queryAllAvailableUpdates() & fetchAvailableSecurityPatchLevel()): Aggregates data from registered on-device update providers to discover pending security updates across system components.
  • Granular Vulnerability Verification (areCvesPatched()): Checks whether specific CVEs have been resolved on the device, including evaluating vendor supplemental patch records.
  • Update Readiness Assessment (isDeviceFullyUpdated()): Provides high-level checks to evaluate whether a device has installed all available security patches.
  • Vulnerability Reporting (createVulnerabilityReportUrl()): Generates standardized URLs for security bulletins and CVE details.
  • Kotlin & Java Compatibility: Complete asynchronous support via Kotlin Coroutines / Flow and Java ListenableFuture APIs.
